Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) now supports PostgreSQL 11.12 minor version

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) now supports the PostgreSQL 11.12 minor version. The PostgreSQL minor version 11.12 includes multiple fixes and minor improvements. This new minor version is available immediately on all newly created Hyperscale (Citus) server groups in all supported regions and will be delivered as a part of the next scheduled maintenance to the existing server groups.

Learn more about this announcement and see supported regions where Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) is available.
